featured_reviews.name: Roshan Poojary
featured_reviews.review_text:
Never forget to take receipt. The store manager will make excuses of printer being slow, not working etc. and when it comes to return the product in exchange of something else(I’m sure all pet owners understand the need to exchange something for their pet if doesn’t suit them) from their store they will ask for 10% deduction in the previous purchase.
I bought a cat litter for ₹ 360 few days back but my kittens have started staying outdoors and I no longer need the litter. So I went there to return it and get two box of wet food, so whatever was the difference I asked to adjust it in the new purchase, they said only 90% of exchange product will be given and 10% will be deducted cos of no bill and that guy said “kidhar aur se bhi liya ho hum ko kya maalum” when I have been regularly buying cat food/litter box/litter etc since last two months. Well, it was my mistake not to take the bill when I bought the litter cos I was in a hurry and he made excuses of printer(which he has done before too) so if you buy anything 1) don’t expect good experience for returns 2) always take the bill or don’t buy the product.

They say go vocal for local, if local treats their customer like this it’s better to buy from amazon or flip kart

Edit
PS:- it’s not about ₹36, it’s about ethics.
